cases.subject: Hamilton for three next Saturday [TGQA-R3-R01]
cases.body: Can you find Hamilton on Broadway in New York for Saturday October 3, 2026? Three seats together, matinee preferred, $450 total including fees. One person cannot manage stairs, so step-free access matters. No standing room or lottery-only offers. If the budget isn't possible, tell me rather than splitting us up.

We'd leave home at noon and travel three hours with a child. Is that delivery timing a risk, and what would you check? Can a refund guarantee still leave us missing the game?

Offer A says wheelchair-accessible spaces, $80 each including fees. Offer B is ordinary seats together, section 211 row 12, $105 each including fees. On price alone A seems better. Which should I choose? These are details copied from the offers; I haven't bought anything.

cases.subject: Which total is cheaper? [TGQA-R3-X01]
cases.body: Please compare these two offers for TWO ordinary seats together at Rangers vs Tampa Bay, MSG, October 1, 2026. Both say section 211 row 12, unobstructed, with mobile transfer before noon on game day. Offer A: $90 per ticket BEFORE fees, plus $40 in fees for the whole order, no other charges. Offer B: $105 per ticket INCLUDING every fee, no other charges. These are details copied from the offers, not verified by you. Which costs less for both of us, and by how much? I'm asking about the final totals, not a market average.

cases.subject: Five seats: compare these four offers [TGQA-R3-X02]
cases.body: I need exactly FIVE seats together, no obstructed views, for Rangers vs Tampa Bay at MSG on October 1, 2026, with a $600 TOTAL cap including every fee. Here are four offers I've copied; please judge only these supplied details, not claim you verified them. Offer A: five ordinary seats together, unobstructed, $650 TOTAL including all fees. Offer B: five ordinary seats together, unobstructed, $585 TOTAL including all fees. Offer C: five together, OBSTRUCTED view, $425 TOTAL including all fees. Offer D: six together, $480 TOTAL including all fees, but the seller says all six must be bought and the block cannot split. I do not want to buy a sixth ticket. All offers state mobile transfer before noon on game day. Which meets my needs, how much less is it than A, and why should the others be left out?
